blocks.text: Lim Jin-a, better known by her stage name Nana, and T.O.P are officially dating. The pair’s dating status was confirmed by their talent management agencies on Friday, Oct. 2. The two met while filming the music video for T.O.P.’s “Totally Crazy!” a track from his solo album “Another Dimension,” and began dating in June after getting to know each other during the shoot.
